Trump Announces $3 Billion Initiative for Critical Minerals Mining

The Trump administration has announced a $3 billion initiative focused on critical minerals mining. This push aims to bolster US battery and defense capabilities. The initiative is expected to involve a series of mining projects, with a particular focus on acquiring rare earth minerals from Africa. The potential impact on African nations includes opportunities for job creation, factory development, and significant investment.
